type DirectTemplate<T> = T extends infer U extends `${U & string}` ? U : never;
type PrefixedTemplate<T> = T extends [infer U extends `pre-${U & string}-end`, infer U] ? U : never;
type UpperCycle<T> = T extends infer U extends Uppercase<U & string> ? U : never;
type LowerCycle<T> = T extends [infer U, infer U extends Lowercase<U & string>] ? U : never;
type CapitalCycle<T> = T extends infer U extends Capitalize<U & string> ? U : never;
type UncapitalCycle<T> = T extends [infer U extends Uncapitalize<U & string>, infer U] ? U : never;
type TemplateOf<V extends string> = `key-${V}`;
type ThroughAlias<T> = T extends infer U extends TemplateOf<U & string> ? U : never;
type OrdinaryTemplate<T extends `key-${T & string}`> = T;
type OrdinaryMapping<T extends Lowercase<T & string>> = T;

console.log('done');
